Hi John —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we kick off the POC: 

POC goal:
- Validate that Redwood inference can meet GreenFin’s latency (<= 250ms for 512-token prompts) and cost targets while maintaining generated summary quality for your private financial reports.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or adjust):
1) Latency: 95th percentile <= 250ms on your representative 512-token prompt set.
2) Quality: F1/ROUGE-style evaluation on the 50 example docset (you provided) vs. baseline must be >= 0.85 relative to your current vendor.
3) Cost: per-inference tokenized cost improvement of >= 20% after batching/quantization configs.
4) No PII leakage observed during 3rd-party red-team test (we’ll supply a short probe set).

Evaluation plan & timeline (3-week POC):
- Week 0 (pre-kick): Legal + data access (DocuSign + S3 access) — target complete by Fri, Mar 5.
- Week 1 (Mar 8–12): Environment & model selection, baseline runs on 10 sample docs.
- Week 2 (Mar 15–19): Integration with batch API, KV caching enabled, run full 50-doc eval.
- Week 3 (Mar 22–26): Quality review, cost tuning, wrap-up + exec readout.

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (engagement lead), Dev (technical lead), Rishi (CS escalation).
- GreenFin: John (product lead), Sarah (engineering lead).

Immediate asks for GreenFin before kickoff:
1) Confirm you’re OK with the success criteria above (or suggest edits).
2) Provide sample dataset (CSV/zip) and a user who can provision S3 access or a secure upload.
3) Target kick-off week (we propose Mar 8).

I’ve attached our short POC checklist and the evaluation template to speed approvals.

Attachments: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi John & Marissa —

We can absolutely run a soft kickoff the week of Mar 8 to provision infra and run model bench tests without your production data. Notes below: 

Infra footprint (for benchmark runs):
- Instance: 1x A10G-equivalent GPU (we use cloud provider mapping; we’ll pick the closest match for your region).
- Expected run hours for baseline 50-doc eval: ~6–8 GPU hours (single model); with parallelization 2–3 hours.
- Storage: S3 bucket + temp disk < 5GB for artifacts.

Ballpark POC cost (Redwood-managed infra, incl. runtime): $800–1,200 for the soft kickoff + baseline runs; full 3-week active evaluation (integration + iterative tuning) typically lands $2,500–4,000. We’ll provide a usage report during the wrap.

Technical checklist for Mar 15 data handoff (what we’ll need):
- S3 read credentials or pre-signed upload access.
- Sample schema description and expected tokenization quirks (tables/columns to include).
- A contact for network/security (Sarah recommended).

Attachments: redwood-setup-instructions.txt (contains S3 upload steps & temporary credentials TTL notes).

I’ll provision a staging env Mon (Mar 8) and post the endpoint + credentials in this thread.
